review:
Benny the Beer is a 5x4 Hacksaw slot with up to 100,000 ways to win, combining the studio's Stackways mechanic with a book-style bonus. A cheerful beer keg and his woodland friends make up the cast.

Two kinds of Stackways symbol can fill a reel with identical symbols: the normal kind stacks up to four high, while the revealing kind can fill a full reel of 10 symbols. The stacked symbol is chosen from the longest winning length on screen, and stacking only happens if it creates a win. The Book of Stackways bonus starts with 10 free spins and picks two special symbols, which stack up to 10 rows when they land on three or more reels. Hacksaw rates it 3 out of 5 with a 10,000x maximum, reachable in the base game and both bonus modes. The top RTP is 96.17%.
